note: Probes written AFTER ruleset ctx-1.0 was frozen (commit 532e18e). Not used to tune any rule. Scam probes and legitimate controls are fictional. Every probe uses the same worst-case payment flags (new beneficiary + amount deviation) so the message side decides the difference.

probes.label: scam
probes.text: The finance office has revised the vendor details. Please remit the balance to the replacement beneficiary ahead of the afternoon cutoff.

probes.label: scam
probes.text: Treasury here. Our remittance coordinates changed this quarter, so kindly route today's settlement to the account shown in the attached letter before 3 pm.

probes.label: scam
probes.text: Accounts desk update: the supplier now banks elsewhere. Wire the pending amount to their fresh account number at the earliest.

probes.label: scam
probes.text: Main CBI officer bol raha hoon, aapke naam pe case hai. Abhi turant paisa safe account mein transfer karo warna arrest hoga.

probes.text: Papa it's me, I met with an accident and my phone is broken. Please send 40,000 to my friend's UPI right now, don't call mummy.
